dialogue.exportHint: Export the current file, or only checked lines if any are selected.
dialogue.empty: No lines yet — pick a character and write below
dialogue.composerPlaceholder: Write a line… Use @ to pick a character
dialogue.modelNodeHint: Default camera focus fallback when focus_node is empty
dialogue.textColorHint: Leave empty for engine default body color (usually white); do not use character color. Hex only for highlights (#RGB / #RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA)
dialogue.invalidFontSize: Font size must be a positive integer; cleared
dialogue.createDialogueHint: Bind this file to a Godot scene and dialogue id for your plugin.
dialogue.createDialogueHintAutoName: Fill in the Godot scene and dialogue id. The file name is generated automatically (scene + dialogue id). Rename later via the explorer context menu.
dialogue.metaRequired: Godot scene and dialogue id are required
dialogue.unknownSpeaker: Selected character is missing — create or re-pick
dialogue.confirmDeleteCharacterUsed: This character is still used by lines in this file. Delete anyway? Lines will show as unknown.
dialogue.speaker: Speaker
dialogue.graphHint: Graph: drag from bottom for options (empty label = next); double-click edge to edit
dialogue.openingHint: Only one opening per dialogue (CSV first row). Cannot uncheck; set another line as opening instead.
dialogue.noSelfLink: Cannot link a line to itself
dialogue.noMixedEmptyOptions: Cannot mix empty-text continue with labeled choices on the same line
dialogue.inspectorEmpty: Select a node or choice edge to edit
dialogue.sequenceNotToEnd: Connect to End with an option edge
dialogue.oneSequenceOnly: Use option edges from the bottom
dialogue.noCycle: Cannot link a line to itself
dialogue.saveGraphInconsistent: Graph data looks inconsistent — blocked writing an empty dialogue CSV. Re-open the file and try again.

characters.empty: No characters yet — add one above
characters.confirmDelete: Delete this character? Lines that reference it will show as unknown.
characters.idLocked: Character id cannot change after create (dialogue speaker references it)
characters.operableHint: Operable: empty-text options wait for confirm. Non-operable: empty-text auto-advances.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Appearance, language, and AI for KENTUCKY.
settings.aiDesc: OpenAI-compatible API. Add multiple profiles (URL / model / key) and switch them in the agent composer. Keys are encrypted under app data/.
settings.aiReviewHint: By type: edits to existing prose / mind maps / multi-file need Accept; new or empty files, single cast upsert, ≤5 dialogue lines, and layout-only auto-apply. Force review overrides autos.
settings.webSearchDesc: Optional. Off by default. Agent/Plan can use DuckDuckGo multi-query research when enabled.
settings.webSearchProviderHint: DuckDuckGo auto-falls back to Bing if blocked. Prefer Bing on restricted networks. Brave/Tavily need API keys later.
settings.skillsDesc: Global skills live under app data/ai-skills/<id>/SKILL.md (Cursor-style). Scripts inside skills are never executed.
settings.skillsEmpty: No skills yet — open the folder and add SKILL.md, or import a folder.

ai.title: Agent
ai.needKey: Add an API key in Settings to start chatting.
ai.placeholder: Ask about your writing… (@file to mention)
ai.promptContinue: Continue writing from the current selection or active file in the same voice.
ai.promptPolish: Polish the selection or active passage for clarity and literary quality without changing meaning.
ai.promptExpand: Expand the selection with more sensory detail and subtext.
ai.promptCompress: Tighten the selection; cut fluff while keeping voice.
ai.promptConsistency: Check character voice and continuity against characters.csv and recent dialogue; propose fixes if needed.
